LESSON 29 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Absolute, relative and root-relative URLs

An absolute URL includes a scheme and host. Relative URLs resolve against the document base URL.
A leading slash resolves from the origin root.
Absolute URL එකෙට full address එකෙ තිJයෙනවා. Relative path එකෙ current page එකෙට සාJපේකේෂයි. / එJකෙන් පෙටන් ගන්න path එකෙ origin root එJකෙන් resolve Jවනවා.
A product page loads its photo and links to help.
https://shop.example/products/item.html · photo.png /help https://cdn.example/a · /products/photo.png /help on shop.example cdn.example/a

Read the diagram: The browser resolves a relative image beside item.html, a root-relative link at
the same origin root, and an absolute URL at its own host.
Expected result: Three URLs resolve using the document address and each supplied path.
Interview question: What is the difference between /images/a.png and images/a.png?

Answer: The first resolves from the origin root; the second resolves relative to the document base
URL.
